url.empty: Paste a connection string such as postgres://user:password@localhost:5432/app
url.noScheme: A connection string starts with postgres:// or mongodb://
url.unsupported: Unsupported scheme "{{scheme}}". Use postgres:// or mongodb://
url.noHost: The connection string has no host.
url.severalPostgres: Several PostgreSQL hosts are not supported. Enter a single host.
url.srvOneHost: A mongodb+srv address is one DNS name, without a port.
url.badHost: That connection string could not be read: a host or port is invalid.

form.description: Connect to a database running here, in a container or on another server.
form.connectOnceTitle: Nothing is saved: the connection, its password, history and tabs are gone when you close the app
form.urlHint: The password in the string is kept in the system's secure storage, not in the connection record. Pasting a string fills in the other settings.
form.readOnlyHint: The server refuses statements that change data. Turn off to write.
form.prodWrites: This is a production connection with writes enabled. Destructive statements will still ask first.

tlsMode.verify-full: Verify the chain and the host name (recommended)

form.requireWarning: The connection is encrypted but the server is not authenticated, so someone in the middle could impersonate it.
form.caHint: Without a CA file the system trust store is used.
form.sshEnable: Connect through an SSH server (bastion host)
form.agentHint: Uses the keys loaded in your running SSH agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK, or the OpenSSH agent on Windows). Nothing is stored here.
form.passphraseHint: Only if the key is encrypted
form.hostKeyHint: The first time, you will be shown the server's key fingerprint to confirm. A different key later is refused.
form.srv: Seed list (mongodb+srv — the host is a DNS name)
form.direct: Connect directly to this host (skip replica-set discovery)
form.agentRead: Read — agents may ask to read, each request needs your approval
form.agentWrite: Read and write — every change needs your approval
form.agentProd: Agents can never write to a production connection.
form.maskHint: one per line; any column or field containing it is masked
form.failed: The connection could not be saved
form.trustConfirm: Trust this key and test again
form.trustDescription: {{host}} has not been seen before. Compare this fingerprint with the one your server reports (for example with ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub).
form.keyChanged: The SSH server's host key changed. This can mean the server was rebuilt, or that someone is intercepting the connection. Do not continue until you have confirmed it with whoever runs the server.
